lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed as a series of 4-5 primary horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters extending from the post-gill region to the caudal peduncle, maintaining a semi-regular grid spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, each defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to low-luminance ventral shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs of irregular size, distributed primarily across the lower two-thirds of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-luminance trailing structures extend from the pelvic region; several dark, fusiform pixel clusters (remoras) are attached to the ventral midline posterior to the pectoral fin.
